newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP August iron ore, coal output up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP August iron ore, coal output up.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its production of iron ore rose three percent and coal output increased five percent in August,
compared with the same month last year.
Iron ore production totalled 4.7 million tonnes and coal output 1.98 million tonnes in August 1996, BHP said.

Higher coal production in Queensland and in Indonesia boosted overall coal output, though this was partly offset by lower production in the United States and in the Australian state of New South Wales, BHP said.
BHP Minerals division output (million tonnes unless stated)
Shipments of iron ore fell in August. "Shipments of iron ore from Australia, while higher in the quarter, fell for August due to the timing of customer nominations from Newman," BHP said.
NOTE: August is the third month of BHP's financial year.
